title: JobSpec/JobHandle/JobStatus/JobResult, role-result and evidence schemas
description: SPEC §4.3, §10.1 / §12 Phase 0 step 3. Versioned JSON schemas in the bundle for the four-operation executor protocol records and for role-result and evidence records, including the credentials grant on JobSpec (issued by host, source grade, metered vs flat-rate cost semantics) and revocation semantics on cancel. Provide golden example documents (the illustrative ones in the spec) that validate, and negative examples that do not.
acceptance_criteria: Schemas live in the bundle with schema_version; golden examples validate and negative examples fail from both Go and TypeScript; JobSpec carries a credentials object with model and source grade; the schemas are referenced from the spec by path.
